5.speaker: Elena Werner

9.speaker: Elena Werner
9.text: "The trip was quicker last time. Or I was just younger..."

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: She pinned a strand of grey hair behind her ear as we began walking towards the MITZ headquarters.

11.speaker: Elena Werner
11.text: "Ready for the final vote, Your Majesty?"

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "Remind me again. How much do we have riding on this?"

14.speaker: Elena Werner
14.text: "Thanks to our new gold mine in Qalus, we are much less dependent on international gold production."
14.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_RRGNationalization_ByCash"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_RRGNationalization_ByForce"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Completed"] == true)

15.speaker: Elena Werner
15.text: "Nationalizing Rizian Royal Gold has vastly increased our income from the gold mined within our own country."

22.speaker: Elena Werner
22.text: "Admittedly, it is unlikely we'll find any new gold sources in Rizia in the near future."
22.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_RRGNationalization_ByCash"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn08_RRGNationalization_ByForce"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Completed"] == true) == false)

23.speaker: Elena Werner
23.text: "But our other industries are booming to the extent that gold really doesn't matter to us so much anymore."

27.speaker: Elena Werner
27.text: "Which is troubling, because a large percentage of our economy still depends on gold."

31.speaker: Elena Werner
31.text: "And honestly, our other industries are booming to the extent that our gold income serves as little more than icing on the proverbial cake."

32.speaker: Elena Werner
32.text: "Which is fortunate, because a large percentage of our economy still depends on gold."

36.speaker: Elena Werner
36.text: "Between that and our new mine in Qalus, we have become much less dependent on international gold production."

40.speaker: Elena Werner
40.text: "I will warn you that our proposal to completely forego a share in the nationalized MITZ will cause considerable financial damage if it goes through."

44.speaker: Elena Werner
44.text: "I will warn you that our proposal to shrink our share in the MITZ will cause some financial damage if it goes through."
44.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Nationalization_NoShare"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_SmallerShare"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Nationalization_SmallerShare"] == true)

45.speaker: Elena Werner
45.text: "So we have a vested interest in making sure the proposal we agreed on with Morella goes through."
45.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Nationalization_NoShare"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_SmallerShare"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Nationalization_SmallerShare"] == true) == false)

49.speaker: Elena Werner
49.text: "Our proposal to completely forego a share in the nationalized MITZ will still cause some financial damage if it goes through."

53.speaker: Elena Werner
53.text: "Our proposal to shrink our share in the MITZ will cause a small amount of financial damage if it goes through."
53.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Nationalization_NoShare"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_SmallerShare"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Nationalization_SmallerShare"] == true)

54.speaker: Elena Werner
54.text: "It will still be of some financial benefit to us if the proposal we agreed on with Morella goes through."
54.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Nationalization_NoShare"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_SmallerShare"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Nationalization_SmallerShare"] == true) == false)

55.speaker: Elena Werner
55.text: "In light of that, I'd advise you to go into this meeting with the intention of strengthening our international partnerships, rather than maximizing our returns."

56.speaker: Elena Werner
56.text: "But I would advise you to go into this meeting with the intention of strengthening our international partnerships, not maximizing our returns."

57.speaker: Elena Werner
57.text: "I'd advise you to think about how we can maximize our returns. Even if it costs us an international partnership or two."

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "I fully intend to come out of this building with both our gold income and our international relations intact, Ms. Werner."

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "Morella's support is key to my plans for a South Merkopan alliance. I have to keep Saltana happy at all costs."

63.speaker: Player_Romus
63.text: "Our relations with all of our MITZ partners are already fragile thanks to the war. I don't want to do anything to upset them."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "Rizia is anchored in gold. The more of it we have, the better. Damn the consequences."

68.speaker: Elena Werner
68.text: "That was Her Majesty Queen Lyza's mindset as well."

69.speaker: Elena Werner
69.text: "Then I wish you the best of luck."

71.speaker: Elena Werner
71.text: "We're four countries with four differing interests. Someone will likely get upset, Your Majesty."

72.speaker: Narrator
72.text: We kept walking until we reached the entrance of the headquarters.

73.speaker: Player_Romus
73.text: "Do you still think our proposal is a good idea?"

74.speaker: Player_Romus
74.text: "Yes. It's time for Morella to get its proper due."

75.speaker: Narrator
75.text: Alvarez had a smug expression on his face as I took my place next to him.

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "I made a promise to Lespia. I have to vote their way, no matter what Morella threatens."

85.speaker: Alma Saltana
85.text: "In accordance with a majority of stakeholders, we have negotiated a draft proposal for the nationalization of the Trade Zone."
85.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_Failed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_LespiaScrewedOverRizia"] == false) == false)

86.speaker: Alma Saltana
86.text: "Unfortunately, we could not reach a concord between stakeholders, and a new direction for the Meftiem International Trade Zone could not be determined.

87.speaker: Alma Saltana
87.text: "I thank my partners for their generosity and cooperation during this process."

88.speaker: Alma Saltana
88.text: "And I am happy to assure everyone gathered here that nobody will go home empty-handed."

93.speaker: Narrator
93.text: An aide approached Saltana with a briefcase. She opened it and took out a single piece of paper.

94.speaker: Alma Saltana
94.text: "The Meftiem International Trade Zone Nationalization Agreement of 1957."

95.speaker: Alma Saltana
95.text: "All currently existing assets within the Meftiem Basin will be brought under Morellan state ownership."

96.speaker: Alma Saltana
96.text: "From henceforth, operations in the Trade Zone will be overseen by a new state corporation, Muardien Mining and Trade."

97.speaker: Alma Saltana
97.text: "The government of Morella will own a 60 percent stake in this new company."

101.speaker: Alma Saltana
101.text: "The remaining 40 percent will go to Lespia."

102.speaker: Alma Saltana
102.text: "The remaining 40 percent will go to Rizia."

109.speaker: Alma Saltana
109.text: "The governments of Rizia and Lespia will receive a 20 percent stake each."

110.speaker: Alma Saltana
110.text: "The government of Morella will own an 80 percent stake in this company."

111.speaker: Alma Saltana
111.text: "The remaining 20 percent will go to Lespia."

112.speaker: Alma Saltana
112.text: "Higher wages and stronger labor and environmental protections will be implemented immediately."

113.speaker: Narrator
113.text: Hegel shook his head in disappointment.

121.speaker: Narrator
121.text: The audience broke into animated whispers.

122.speaker: Alma Saltana
122.text: "However, this does not mean a complete continuation of the status quo. While Rizia and Lespia will continue mining operations with a 25 percent share each, the Republic of Valgsland will be transferring its share to Morella."

126.speaker: Narrator
126.text: I glanced at Alvarez. He gave me a look of warning.

129.speaker: Alma Saltana
129.text: "Each MITZ partner must now give his or her final approval to the proposal."

134.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
134.text: "Lespia votes yes as well. We look forward to building a fairer MITZ together with Morella."

135.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
135.text: "Lespia votes no to the unfair seizure of our assets."
135.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_LespiaScrewedOverRizia"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_WillVoteYes_MITZ"] == true) == false)

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "The Kingdom of Rizia had no part in this proposal and we refuse to approve it."

141.speaker: Player_Romus
141.text: "If the Republic of Morella deems this proposal to be the best choice, I have no other option but to agree to it."

142.speaker: Player_Romus
142.text: "Unfortunately, circumstances have changed. Though I worked closely on this proposal with Morella, I can no longer agree to it."

146.speaker: Player_Romus
146.text: "My kingdom is happy to approve this proposal."

147.speaker: Narrator
147.text: Both Saltana and Hegel stared at me in abject shock.

148.speaker: Alma Saltana
148.text: "Uh, thank you, King Romus... Chancellor Hegel?"

150.speaker: Narrator
150.text: Both Saltana and Hegel gave satisfied nods.

151.text: The Valgslandian chancellor cleared his throat dramatically.

153.speaker: Alma Saltana
153.text: "The new agreement includes some changes to the size of our partners' shares. But rest assured that nobody will be going home empty-handed.'

159.speaker: Alma Saltana
159.text: "The Amended Meftiem International Trade Zone Agreement of 1957."

160.text: "From henceforth, it is agreed that the share of the MITZ previously belonging to Valgsland will be transferred to the Republic of Morella."

161.speaker: Alma Saltana
161.text: "Higher wages and stronger labor and environmental protections will be implemented immediately."

165.speaker: Alma Saltana
165.text: "The other half of the Trade Zone will belong to Lespia."

169.speaker: Alma Saltana
169.text: "The other half of the Trade Zone will belong to Rizia."

190.text: "Lespia votes yes as well. We look forward to building a fairer MITZ together with Morella."

195.text: "Lespia votes no to this unfair sham of an agreement."

201.text: "If the Republic of Morella deems this proposal to be the best choice, I have no other option but to agree to it."

202.speaker: Player_Romus

204.text: "The Kingdom of Rizia gladly approves this proposal."

205.speaker: Player_Romus

216.speaker: Narrator
216.text: There was a round of polite applause.

217.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
217.text: "The Republic of Valgsland cannot approve this proposal."

218.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
218.text: "The Republic of Valgsland approves this proposal."

219.text: Just as the door was being opened for us, an aide rushed up to Elena and whispered something in her ear.

223.speaker: Narrator
223.text: Her face turned white. She pulled me aside.

224.speaker: Elena Werner
224.text: "Your Majesty, there's been a new development."

225.speaker: Elena Werner
225.text: "Apparently Morella and Lespia have reached a last-minute accord."

226.speaker: Elena Werner
226.text: "The nationalization proposal now grants Lespia an additional 20 percent stake in the new MITZ. Leaving us with nothing."

230.speaker: Elena Werner
230.text: "The renegotiated MITZ proposal now splits the Trade Zone equally between the two countries. Leaving us with nothing."

231.speaker: Player_Romus
231.text: "Alvarez double-crossed us? Why am I not surprised?"

233.speaker: Player_Romus
233.text: "Why am I only being informed now? Heads will roll for this."

237.speaker: Player_Romus
237.text: "Let Lespia have its gold. Rizia is an energy superpower now."

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "It doesn't matter. Hegel would never agree to such a thing."

242.speaker: Elena Werner
242.text: "It won't make much of a difference to our income. But being shut out by our own neighbor is terrible for our image."

243.speaker: Elena Werner
243.text: "Given the war, it was inevitable that Lespia would turn against us. I'm just disappointed that Morella went along with it."

247.speaker: Elena Werner
247.text: "It was always a possibility that Lespia would turn against us. I'm just disappointed that Morella went along with it."

248.speaker: Elena Werner
248.text: "I'm truly sorry. I did tell you it would be a possibility."

249.speaker: Elena Werner
249.text: "I'm surprised Morella went along with it, though."

252.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
252.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Unfriendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Hostile"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad"] == true) == false

253.speaker: Elena Werner
253.text: "A few years ago, I would've said you were right. Now... I don't know."

254.speaker: Elena Werner
254.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Unfriendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Hostile"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad"] == true) == false

257.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Unfriendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Hostile"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad"] == true) == false

258.speaker: Narrator
258.text: She let out a long sigh.

259.speaker: Elena Werner
259.text: "Especially if Hegel supports it as well..."

263.speaker: Elena Werner
263.text: "At least Hegel will never go for it."

264.speaker: Elena Werner
264.text: "And unfortunately, we can no longer count on Valgsland's veto..."

265.speaker: Elena Werner
265.text: "At least Hegel will never support such a thing."
265.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Unfriendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Hostile"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad"] == true) == false

266.speaker: Narrator
266.text: We were about to enter the building when Chancellor Emmerich Hegel and the rest of the Valgish delegation walked past us.

267.speaker: Narrator
267.text: Hegel looked me in the eye and nodded in greeting, his expression unreadable.

270.speaker: Player_Romus
270.text: "Chancellor. May I have a moment of your time?"

272.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
272.text: "I fully intend for it to be a good day, Mr. Toras."

278.speaker: Elena Werner
278.text: "I admire your commitment to our neighbor's welfare, Your Majesty. But I hope you're considering Rizia's as well."

279.speaker: Player_Romus
279.text: "Of course I'm ready. It's not like anything is going to change."

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "There had better not be any unpleasant surprises."

281.speaker: Player_Romus
281.text: "I'm ready to have this MITZ nonsense over with."

285.speaker: Player_Romus
285.text: "I'm ready for Morella to stop wasting my time. There's a war going on."

290.speaker: Elena Werner
290.text: "Saltana doesn't see it as a waste."

291.speaker: Elena Werner
291.text: "Not that it's any of my business, but this might be our last chance to nip the Malenyevist threat in the bud."

294.speaker: Elena Werner
294.text: "Her revolutionaries haven't posed much of a threat to Rizia yet. But anything can happen..."
294.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Morella_Funds_Revolutionaries"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Revolutionaries_NonThreat"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Morella_ConfrontedWithSabotageEvidence"] == true) == false)

295.speaker: Elena Werner
295.text: "Not that it's any of my business."

303.speaker: Elena Werner
303.text: "Trust me. I know the signs of a coming uprising when I see one..."

304.speaker: Elena Werner
304.text: "I really am getting too old for this."

312.speaker: Narrator
312.text: Saltana gasped audibly. Alvarez didn't look surprised.

313.speaker: Narrator
313.text: There was a round of polite applause. Saltana smiled in obvious relief.

320.speaker: Narrator
320.text: The Morellan prime minister took a moment to compose herself.

321.speaker: Alma Saltana
321.text: "It seems we do not have an agreement after all. The Meftiem International Trade Zone will not be nationalized."

325.speaker: Alma Saltana
325.text: "By unanimous vote, the Meftiem International Trade Zone nationalization plan will be implemented."

326.speaker: Alma Saltana
326.text: "By a 3-1 vote, the Meftiem International Trade Zone nationalization plan will be implemented."
326.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_MITZVote_RiziaYes"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_MITZVote_LespiaYes"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_MITZVote_RiziaYes"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_MITZVote_LespiaYes"] == true)

327.speaker: Alma Saltana
327.text: "This is a momentous occasion. I thank you all for joining us here today, and invite you to stay for celebrations."

331.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
331.text: "The Republic of Valgsland approves this proposal."
331.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_LespiaScrewedOverRizia"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_ValgslandCSP"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Valgsland_Unfriendly"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Bad"] == true)

333.speaker: Emmerich Hegel (R)
333.text: "The Republic of Valgsland approves this proposal."

337.speaker: Narrator
337.text: Both Saltana and Alvarez stared at him in abject shock.

338.speaker: Narrator
338.text: There was a round of polite applause. Saltana smiled in obvious relief.

342.speaker: Narrator
342.text: The Morellan prime minister took a moment to compose herself.

343.speaker: Alma Saltana
343.text: "This is a momentous occasion. I thank you all for joining us here today, and invite you to stay for celebrations."

347.speaker: Narrator
347.text: Elena cornered me as I came out of the room.

348.speaker: Elena Werner
348.text: "Well, Your Majesty? What was that about?"

353.speaker: Player_Romus
353.text: "No time to explain. Let's get to the vote."

356.speaker: Elena Werner
356.text: "That's wonderful news. I'll refrain from asking how."

357.speaker: Narrator
357.text: We were ushered into the main conference hall. Elena split off for her seat as I was led to one of the four podiums onstage.

358.speaker: Elena Werner
358.text: "The day we're 'friendly' with Chancellor Hegel is the day I eat my own hat."

359.speaker: Elena Werner
359.text: "All right. I'll refrain from prying further."

368.speaker: Narrator
368.text: Alvarez gave a cordial nod as I took my place next to him.
368.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_LespiaScrewedOverRizia"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_WillVoteYes_MITZ"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_Nationalization"] == false)

369.speaker: Narrator

391.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. This will be a boon for all of us."

392.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
392.text: "And a real thorn in the side of Madam Prime Minister over there."

393.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
393.text: "I hope you're happy with yourself today, Your Majesty."

400.speaker: Narrator

401.speaker: Alma Saltana
401.text: "Several years ago, the Republic of Morella began an initiative to bring the resources of the Meftiem Basin under the stewardship of our state and our people."

406.speaker: Alma Saltana
406.text: "That is not the only gesture of faith that Chancellor Emmerich Hegel has extended to us."

407.speaker: Alma Saltana
407.text: "We are also pleased to announce that Morella is now on a fast track for candidacy in the Contanan Security Pact."

408.speaker: Alma Saltana
408.text: "We are thereby able to pledge that our half of the Trade Zone will be run with fairness and respect to both workers and the environment."

409.speaker: Narrator
409.text: The chatter in the hall grew louder. I saw Prime Minister Alvarez bang a fist on his podium.

413.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
413.text: "First Sordland, now Morella... The communists will eat our continent alive."

414.speaker: Player_Romus
414.text: "I suppose you won't be happy to know that I promised Caleqabiz to the CSP."

415.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
415.text: "The communists can try all they want. But they won't win."

419.speaker: Player_Romus
419.text: "We're keeping our gold mines. Just as we planned."

420.speaker: Player_Romus
420.text: "We will oppose them with our dying breath."

421.speaker: Player_Romus
421.text: "If that is what God wills... so be it."

425.speaker: Player_Romus
425.text: "Don't speak to me as if I am your ally."

429.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
429.text: "Let's hope it doesn't come to that, Your Majesty."

431.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
431.text: "But for how long, Your Majesty? This doesn't bode well for either of us."

432.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
432.text: "Petty grudges mean nothing in the greater battle between East and West, Your Majesty."

433.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
433.text: "Let's see if you can keep up that sanguine attitude when they come for your head."

435.speaker: Alma Saltana
435.text: "Unfortunately, not all stakeholders agreed on this new direction for the Trade Zone."

436.speaker: Alma Saltana
436.text: "But after several rounds of negotiations, we were able to come to a compromise that preserved the MITZ's structure while introducing new measures."

440.speaker: Alma Saltana
440.text: "In this new agreement, each of our partners are able to keep their existing share. Nobody will be going home empty-handed."

447.text: "The Republic of Valgsland cannot approve this proposal."

460.speaker: Alma Saltana

529.speaker: Alma Saltana

530.speaker: Alma Saltana
530.text: "Valgsland, Sordland, Morella -- a new axis of solidarity is forming on this continent. It may not happen today, but the forces of justice will prevail."

534.speaker: Alma Saltana

539.speaker: Alma Saltana
539.text: "I will take questions shortly. For now, please talk amongst yourselves."

558.speaker: Player_Romus
